jobs.title: .NET Engineer - Remote Opportunity
jobs.description:
# .NET Software Engineer – .NET 10.0 / C# 14

## About the Role

Our client is a global software company developing products and applications designed to help individuals and teams achieve their personal and professional goals. With nearly **500 employees and continued growth**, the company is expanding its global engineering team and seeking a **.NET Software Engineer** to contribute to the development of next-generation software products.

In this role, you will work on enterprise-level **.NET and C# software development projects**, transforming product concepts into production-ready solutions. The company provides opportunities to develop expertise across modern Microsoft technologies, including .NET 10.0, ASP.NET Core, C# 14, Azure, Angular, Vue.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, and EF Core.

## Key Responsibilities

* Develop and enhance next-generation **.NET / C# software products**.

* Contribute to enterprise-level software development projects.

* Design, develop, and maintain applications using the **.NET and .NET Core** ecosystem.

* Work with **ASP.NET Core** and Web API technologies.

* Develop and integrate **RESTful APIs**.

* Work with **Azure and Azure SQL** technologies.

* Apply software development principles such as **SOLID and DRY**.

* Develop solutions using **LINQ, Entity Framework Core, and related Microsoft technologies**.

* Contribute to full-stack development using frontend technologies such as **Angular, Vue.js, and TypeScript**.

* Work with concepts including **multithreading** and modern application architecture.

* Collaborate with global engineering teams to deliver software products.

* Continue developing technical expertise through training and exposure to modern technologies.

## Required Qualifications

* Professional experience as a **.NET Software Engineer / C# Developer / Full Stack Developer** or in a closely related software engineering role.

* Good working knowledge of:

* **.NET**

* **.NET Core**

* **C#**

* **Azure SQL**

* Experience with software development and enterprise-level applications.

* Ability to work with modern software engineering practices and technologies.

## Preferred Qualifications

The source indicates that the company will provide training and development opportunities in the following technologies:

* .NET 10.0

* ASP.NET Core

* C# 14

* Azure

* Angular 21

* Vue.js

* TypeScript

* Multithreading

* RESTful APIs

* ASP.NET Core Web API

* Entity Framework Core 10.0

* SOLID

* DRY

* LINQ

* MongoDB

Experience with these technologies may therefore be beneficial but is **not stated as a mandatory requirement**.

## Skills & Competencies

* .NET / .NET Core

* C#

* ASP.NET Core

* ASP.NET Core Web API

* Azure

* Azure SQL

* Entity Framework Core

* RESTful API development

* Angular

* Vue.js

* TypeScript

* LINQ

* MongoDB

* Multithreading

* SOLID principles

* DRY principles

* Enterprise software development

* Full-stack development

* Software architecture

## Education & Experience

* Relevant professional experience in **.NET / C# software development** is required.

* No specific degree or formal educational qualification is stated in the source job description.

## Work Arrangement & Location

* **Location:** Lucerne, Switzerland.

* **Work Arrangement:** Remote working available.

* Applicants **must be based in Switzerland** and have the **right to work in Switzerland**.

* Employees are eligible to visit and work from the company's international offices **twice per year**.

* The company covers travel and lodging costs for a **two-week period** for these international office visits.

## Compensation & Benefits

* **Salary:** CHF 120,000 – CHF 140,000 per year.

* **Bonus:** 10–20%.

* **Holiday subsidy:** CHF 2,000 once per year.

* Catered lunches, snacks, and beverages.

* Annual **Netflix and Spotify** subscriptions.

* Employee entertainment activities, including Tea Time Tuesdays, Ice Coffee Thursdays, and Beer O'Clock Fridays.

* International office work opportunities twice per year, with travel and lodging covered for a two-week period.

## Career Development

The company emphasizes internal career development and talent recognition, with opportunities to progress according to individual ambition and performance. The source highlights an example of a CTO who progressed from a Senior .NET Software Engineer role to leading Asian operations.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (a)
jobs.description:
80% - 100% | Luzern | Homeoffice möglich

Jetzt bewerben

Du gestaltest die Zukunft des elektronischen Briefkastens (eBK): Auf Basis einer modernen Dapr-/Container-/Kubernetes-Architektur entwickelst du die CI/CD-Pipeline und das React-Frontend weiter und begleitest die Betriebsübernahme von externen Lieferanten in den DIIN-Eigenbetrieb. Gemeinsam mit CMI & aforms, CISO, Product Owner und Produktmanagement schaffst du die Grundlage für einen sicheren, stabilen und selbständigen Betrieb des eBK.

Deine Aufgaben

Plattform-Betrieb: Die Weiterentwicklung und den Betrieb des eBK auf Basis der Dapr-/Container-/Kubernetes-Architektur stellst du sicher und baust die Fehler- und Edge-Case-Behandlung für eine robuste Applikation aus.
Frontend & Integration: Das React-Frontend für die Integration des Briefkasten-Symbols in my.lu.ch entwickelst du weiter und setzt die CMI-Integration um.
CI/CD & sicherer Eigenbetrieb: Den Aufbau der CI/CD-Pipeline für den eBK treibst du voran und schaffst mit CI/CD-Souveränität und Vault Auto-Unseal die Grundlage für einen sicheren Eigenbetrieb.
Betriebsübernahme: Die fachliche Betriebsübernahme von externen Lieferanten zur DIIN begleitest du inklusive Abnahmeprozess und Wissenstransfer und sorgst damit für einen stabilen, qualitativ hochwertigen Betrieb.
Anforderungen & Security: Anforderungen unterschiedlicher Anspruchsgruppen analysierst, strukturierst und priorisierst du, entwickelst daraus nachhaltige Lösungskonzepte und koordinierst Releases und Changes. Als Bindeglied zwischen Fachbereichen und Entwicklung bringst du fachliche Anforderungen, technische Möglichkeiten und Nutzerbedürfnisse zusammen und setzt Massnahmen aus Tenable-Scanning und Pentests um.

Dein Profil

Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Senior DevOps-/Full-Stack-Engineer mit fundierter Praxis in React und C# sowie im Betrieb von Container-/Kubernetes-Umgebungen; Kenntnisse in Dapr oder vergleichbaren Microservice-Runtimes sind von Vorteil.
Erfahrung im Aufbau von CI/CD-Pipelines, beispielsweise mit Azure DevOps, für containerisierte Applikationen sowie in REST-API-Integrationen.
Praxis in der Übernahme und Migration von Applikationen von externen Lieferanten in den Eigenbetrieb sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für einen zuverlässigen Betrieb. Dabei überzeugst du mit Hands-on-Umsetzungsstärke und verbindest Frontend- mit Betriebs-Know-how.
Ein hohes Sicherheitsbewusstsein und sorgfältiger, verlässlicher Umgang mit sicherheitskritischen Bürgerdaten und Dokumenten, insbesondere im Kontext vertraulicher Zustellung. Professionelles Auftreten gegenüber externen Lieferanten sowie die Bereitschaft, fehlende Kompetenzen im Team aktiv aufzubauen und Wissen weiterzugeben, zeichnen dich aus. Stilsichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.

Von Vorteil
:

Erfahrung in der öffentlichen Verwaltung oder in regulierten Branchen.
Erfahrung mit Dokumentenmanagement-/Case-Management-Systemen wie CMI sowie Kenntnisse von eCH-Standards und Anforderungen an die digitale Zustellung.

Worauf du dich freuen kannst

Unsere Wirkungsfelder sind so vielfältig wie wir.

Umwelt, Infrastruktur, Finanzen, Sicherheit, Gesundheit, Bildung und noch vieles mehr - gemeinsam gestalten wir den Kanton Luzern.

Mit uns kommst du weiter.

Wir bieten attraktive und spannende Karriere- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – sowohl in der Führung als auch für Fachexpertinnen und Fachexperten.

Wir arbeiten flexibel und smart.

Bei uns hat mobil-flexibles Arbeiten einen hohen Stellenwert. Mehr als die Hälfte unserer Mitarbeitenden arbeiten in Teilzeit und verwirklichen ihre beruflichen Ziele im Einklang mit ihren privaten Engagements.

Bei uns profitierst du.

Attraktive Weiterbildungsangebote, Rabattplattformen für Mitarbeitende, Mobile- und Internetangebote, Next Bike, Flottenrabatte, und weitere Benefits.

Alle unsere Benefits auf einen Blick

Dein Arbeitgeber

Arbeiten beim Kanton Luzern
heisst, die Zukunft mitzugestalten - die des Kantons, seiner Einwohnerinnen und Einwohner und nicht zuletzt die eigene. Zur ausgezeichneten Lebensqualität in unserem Kanton leisten täglich mehr als 7'000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter in 200 verschiedenen Berufen ihren Beitrag.

Die Dienststelle Informatik
(DIIN) erbringt umfassende IT-Dienstleistungen für die Departemente, Gerichte und Schulen des Kantons Luzern. Neben der Beratung zu Fragestellungen der Informatik in den Bereichen Architektur, Sicherheit, Infrastruktur, Projekte und Applikationen und der Bereitstellung von IT-Services betreibt sie die kantonale Informatikinfrastruktur in zwei modernen Rechenzentren und ist für den Aufbau und den Betrieb des komplexen kantonalen Kommunikationsnetzes besorgt.

Das «a» im Stellentitel steht für «alle». Der Kanton Luzern steht für Diversität und Vielfalt.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Front and Back end)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer (Front and Back end) based in Switzerland.

As a Software Engineer, you’ll contribute across both frontend and backend development to build reliable, scalable applications in modern cloud environments.

You’ll work with technologies spanning Java, JavaScript, Python, web frameworks, containerization, and cloud infrastructure.

The role combines hands-on software development with deployment automation, CI/CD, and modern application delivery practices.

You’ll collaborate within an Agile development environment, contributing to technical planning, implementation, testing, and continuous improvement.

Your work will help deliver secure and resilient applications while supporting efficient deployment across complex cloud platforms.

You’ll operate in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where strong problem-solving, communication, and ownership are essential.

This opportunity is well suited to an engineer who enjoys working across the full application stack and adapting to evolving technical challenges.

Accountabilities

Develop and maintain software applications using Java, JavaScript, Python, or related technologies.
Build and enhance frontend applications using modern web technologies including HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript ES6+.
Develop user interfaces with frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js, including relevant state management solutions such as Redux, NgRx, or Vuex.
Contribute to backend application development and integration using technologies such as Java, Python, C#, and .NET.
Design, deploy, and maintain containerized applications using Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, Containerd, or similar technologies.
Support application deployment across cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, OpenStack, or OpenShift.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated build processes, deployment workflows, and configuration tools.
Participate in Agile development practices and use collaboration and project management tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to design solutions, troubleshoot technical issues, and deliver project objectives.
Apply strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to address technical challenges and improve application reliability.
Contribute to on-time project delivery through effective planning, prioritization, and time management.
Maintain clear technical communication and documentation throughout the development lifecycle.

Requirements

4-year degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
Professional development experience with at least one of Java, JavaScript, or Python.
Strong knowledge of core web technologies, including HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
Hands-on experience with at least one major frontend framework or library, such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Familiarity with frontend state management technologies such as Redux, NgRx, or Vuex.
Familiarity with C# and .NET is preferred.
Hands-on experience with application containerization using Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, Containerd, or similar technologies.
Experience deploying containerized applications in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, OpenStack, or OpenShift.
Experience working with CI/CD deployment pipelines, automated builds, and configuration management tools.
Experience working in an Agile software development environment and familiarity with tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams.
Demonstrated ability to build strong working relationships and consistently deliver high-quality results.
Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment.
Strong organizational and time-management skills with a focus on meeting project deadlines.
Familiarity with the space domain is a plus.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Opportunity to work across both frontend and backend software engineering.
Exposure to modern cloud platforms and containerized application environments.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, CI/CD, and Agile development practices.
Opportunity to work with a broad range of programming languages and modern web technologies.
Collaborative environment focused on technical problem-solving and project delivery.
Exposure to complex technology environments and, potentially, space-domain applications.

jobs.title: Coding Specialist (Fluent in Dutch) - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Coding Specialist (Fluent in Dutch) - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Switzerland.

As a Coding Specialist and AI Trainer, you’ll use your software engineering expertise and Dutch fluency to help improve the capabilities of advanced AI systems.

You’ll evaluate how models reason through complex programming challenges across algorithms, architecture, development, infrastructure, and systems programming.

The role combines hands-on technical assessment with linguistic evaluation, requiring you to communicate naturally and precisely in Dutch.

You’ll challenge models with realistic software engineering scenarios, identify weaknesses, and document reproducible failures to improve future model performance.

Your feedback will help strengthen AI reasoning, coding accuracy, technical communication, and problem-solving capabilities.

The position offers flexible remote contract work for technically skilled professionals who enjoy analyzing complex problems and clearly explaining their reasoning.

Your contributions will help shape AI systems designed to support software development, education, research, and other knowledge-intensive applications.

Accountabilities

Engage with advanced AI models on software engineering tasks, technical scenarios, and coding challenges in Dutch.
Evaluate model responses for logical accuracy, technical correctness, coding quality, and adherence to software engineering best practices.
Assess AI performance across areas such as algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend and backend development, cloud infrastructure, and systems programming.
Challenge models with technical topics including asynchronous programming, RESTful API integration, memory management, object-oriented design, secure coding, and distributed systems debugging.
Verify the naturalness, fluency, and correctness of Dutch language usage in technical interactions.
Identify and document model failure modes, errors, and reproducible technical issues with sufficient detail for further analysis.
Provide clear, structured feedback and suggestions to improve model reasoning, coding performance, prompt design, and evaluation methodologies.
Explain technical reasoning clearly and demonstrate your analytical process when evaluating model-generated solutions.
Contribute domain expertise that helps improve AI systems intended to support software development, research, education, and other technical applications.

Requirements

Strong professional coding or software engineering expertise, with experience across areas such as algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend or backend development, cloud infrastructure, or systems programming.
Fluent Dutch language skills, with the ability to communicate naturally and accurately about complex technical subjects.
Strong understanding of software engineering concepts and the ability to critically evaluate technical solutions and code.
Experience with topics such as asynchronous programming, REST APIs, memory management, object-oriented programming, secure coding, or distributed systems is highly relevant.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong attention to technical detail.
Ability to clearly explain technical reasoning and document findings in a structured, reproducible manner.
Strong technical writing skills in Dutch are an advantage.
Bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline is preferred.
Real-world software development experience or open-source contributions is a plus.
Strong metacognitive communication skills, including the ability to explain not only what solution is correct but why.
Ability to work independently in a remote, project-based environment and consistently deliver high-quality evaluations.
Comfortable working as an independent contractor and providing your own secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

Benefits

Pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined based on experience, expertise, and geographic location.
Flexible remote contract work.
Opportunity to contribute directly to the development and improvement of advanced AI systems.
Exposure to challenging software engineering problems across a broad range of technical domains.
Opportunity to apply both coding expertise and Dutch language skills in an AI training environment.
Flexible freelance engagement without a fixed employee schedule.
Contractor arrangement with the ability to work remotely from an eligible location.
Contractors are responsible for providing their own secure computer and high-speed internet.
Company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and paid time off are not provided.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements.
